parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: JSON pose overlay for one observed camera frame.
parameters.constraints: At most 3000 UTF-8 bytes. sequence, timestamp, rotation 0...3, and people (0...6 arrays of 17 COCO joints). Each joint is [x,y,confidence], coordinates in 1/10000 image units, confidence 0...1000.

actions.doc: Replace the camera skeleton overlay atomically. Empty people clears previous skeletons. Coordinates describe the upright unmirrored inference image. Does not control physical equipment.

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: Logical yaw in radians. Positive turns toward the right side of the upright image.
parameters.constraints: Finite decimal string within four turns. The adapter maps it to shoulder_pan.

parameters.name: pitch
parameters.description: Logical camera nod in radians. Positive nods toward the bottom of the upright image.
parameters.constraints: Finite decimal string within four turns. The adapter maps it to wrist_flex.

actions.doc: Send one non-settling aim to the arm channel. Empty detections do not emit this tag. Completion means the transport accepted the joint frame.
